mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, c.student_name AS studentName, o.name AS organization_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course(user_id, title, student_name, organization_id, subject, stage, course_type, start_time, end_time, fee, location, note, status, color, reminder_offset_minutes, repeat_type, repeat_end_date, parent_id, student_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{studentName}, #{organizationId}, #{subject}, #{stage}, #{courseType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{fee}, #{location}, #{note}, #{status}, #{color}, #{reminderOffsetMinutes}, #{repeatType}, #{repeatEndDate}, #{parentId}, #{studentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY start_time
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET student_id = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'scheduled' AND start_time < #{end} AND end_time > #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'scheduled' AND start_time < #{end} AND end_time > #{start} AND id != #{excludeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId}
SELECT * FROM course WHERE status = 'scheduled' AND end_time < #{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET status = #{status} WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM course c LEFT JOIN setting st ON st.user_id = c.user_id AND st.setting_key = 'reminderOffset' WHERE c.status = 'scheduled' AND c.start_time >= #{now} AND c.start_time <= DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL COALESCE(CAST(st.setting_value AS SIGNED), c.reminder_offset_minutes, 30) MINUTE)
